title: Fixed Guarded Disc and Carriage Deli Slicer
description: One original complete static countertop deli-slicer appearance. A broad footed low motor base supports one slightly inclined full blunt closed circular disk, a complete rear housing web, a thick partial perimeter guard and a smaller central face cover. Beside the disk, two full low guide rods carry one whole L-section tray with a raised side wall, an underside carriage block and a fixed pusher plate with its projecting grip. A blank control knob completes the empty apparatus. All geometry is newly authored: not the twin abrasive-wheel grinder with a recoloured wheel, the spoked trough-fed chaff cutter or the clamped horizontal mincer. Three opaque PBR roles. One complete prop, zero scenes or food items. Static visual only; no sharpened cutting edge, powered or sliding motion, material removal, operational clearance, food handling instruction, sanitation, load, manufacture or safety claim.
